novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
“你真是个菜鸡啊。”

    “卧槽，你怎么倒了。”

    “哥，没九格怎么办。”

    “凉拌。”

    晚上。

    李西海与李西朋两个人在饭馆，各自坐一张桌子。

    横看竖看，两人都看不对眼。

    吃完饭后，两人分道扬镳。

    想到自己一天亏了特么五千万的资产，他尼玛就是气啊。

    李西朋这狗东西，好好砍传奇不行，非要跟他一起玩三角洲。

    自己新建的号，要体力没体力，要资产没资产，要技术跟没有。

    进到绝密航天，还特么要自己帮他带装备进去。

    然后不到一分钟，两人就双双被踹死。

    李西海一个人血亏几百万。

    一天下来，撤离成功屈指可数。

    要是简单的亏，李西海还想得通，关键是狗东西，他在打架，李西朋尼玛不是在舔包就是在吃。

    被补掉看到李西朋还在吃，当场剐了他的心都有了。

    更气人的是，他还出大红。

    两兄弟当场没打架，还能坐到一个饭馆吃饭，都算是好的了。

    ……

    心神疲惫的回家。

    李西海感觉比特么的熬夜还累。

    简单的说了两句，李西海就进房间了。

    “不问问？”

    李母望着李西海进房后，有些小声的问道。

    她也知道儿子赚了几十万的事情。

    没李父淡定，心里的扑通扑通跳着。

    激动，兴奋都有。

    “不用问。”

    “让他自己决断，问多了不少。”

    李父说道：“你也不要太过关注担心了，儿子大了，有分寸。”

    “还有，不要拿出去说。”

    李母点头道：“我知道，就没有说过一个字。”

    ……

    周五。

    久岸医疗一字板涨停。

    五板已成。

    股民都在嗷嗷叫，妖股已成，七板有望。

    “冲啊。”

    “妖股来了。”
content_en:
"You're such a noob."

    "Damn it, why did you fall?"

    "Brother, what should I do if I don't have nine grids?"

    "Cold salad."

    night.

    Li Xihai and Li Xipeng were in a restaurant, each sitting at a table.

    Looking horizontally and vertically, neither of them looked at each other.

    After eating, the two went their separate ways.

    Thinking that he had lost 50 million yuan in assets in one day, he was so angry.

    Li Xipeng is a piece of shit. If you can't kill the Legend, you have to play Delta with him.

    The new account you create requires physical strength but not physical strength, assets but not assets, and technical skills.

    Entering a top-secret spaceflight, you have to help him bring the equipment in.

    Then in less than a minute, both of them were kicked to death.

    Li Xihai lost several million in blood alone.

    At the end of the day, evacuation successes were few and far between.

    If it was a simple loss, Li Xihai could still figure it out. The key was the dog. He was fighting, and Li Xihai was either licking the bag or eating it.

    When he saw that Li Xipeng was still eating, he was heartbroken when he was chopped off on the spot.

    What's even more annoying is that he also made a big hit.

    The two brothers didn't fight on the spot, and they were able to sit in the same restaurant for dinner, which was considered a good thing.

    …

    Go home exhausted.

    Li Xihai felt even more tired than staying up all night.

    After a few simple words, Li Xihai entered the room.

    "Don't ask?"

    Mother Li asked in a low voice after watching Li Xihai enter the room.

    She also knew that her son had earned hundreds of thousands.

    Not as calm as Father Li, his heart was pounding.

    Excited and excited.

    "No need to ask."

    "Let him make his own decision. It's a lot of questions."

    Father Li said: "Don't worry too much. My son is older and has a sense of proportion."

    "Also, don't talk about it."

    Mother Li nodded and said, "I know, I didn't say a word."

    …

    Friday.

    Jiu'an Medical hit the daily limit.

    The five boards are completed.

    The stock investors are crying, the demon stock has become a reality, and the Q7 board is expected.

    "Go ahead."

    "The demon is coming."
